story.titleZh: 维斯塔潘：「能用的办法都用上了」，巴库仅差十分之一秒无缘赛季首胜
story.summaryZh: 因排位出问题从第八位起步的维斯塔潘说，第一段中性胎「抓地远不如软胎，只能想办法活下来」；安全车来得正是时候，换上软胎后「快了一大截」，他也在第一次重启时超越皮亚斯特里升至第二。收官阶段他始终在拉塞尔身后约一秒，最终仅以十分之一秒之差落败。「我把能用的办法都用上了。」（来源：Formula 1）
story.originalTitle: ‘I was trying everything’ – Max Verstappen gives verdict after missing out on Azerbaijan GP victory
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上离赛季首胜只有一步之遥。
马克斯·维斯塔潘承认，为了在巴库街道上拿下胜利，他「把所有办法都试过了」，但这位红牛车手最终仅以十分之一秒之差不敌乔治·拉塞尔。
由于排位出现问题，这位荷兰车手只能懊恼地从第八位出发参加周六的51圈比赛，但他用中性胎很快就开始追赶。
升至第三后，维斯塔潘在两次安全车重启中的第一次超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，升到第二，从而得以在收官阶段挑战领跑的拉塞尔。
「从第八位起步，我知道不会那么简单，但我们相当顺利地一路追进了前三，只是第一段非常棘手。」这位四届世界冠军说。
「那套中性胎就是不太行，没有我觉得软胎所拥有的抓地力，所以那一段我只是在努力活下来，尽量跟住那些用软胎的车手。
「我觉得那次安全车来得正是时候，大家都能进站换上软胎。一换上软胎，感觉就好多了，简直快了一大截。
「我觉得这一点也体现在，乔治和我换上软胎后，我们把其他所有人甩开了很多。」
最后几圈，维斯塔潘在主直道上始终保持在拉塞尔身后约一秒的距离，红牛在这场比赛中拥有直线速度优势。
瓦尔特利·博塔斯撞车后15号弯出现黄旗，让维斯塔潘在最后一次冲向终点时获得了更强的尾流。但这位荷兰车手最终仅差十分之一秒，这意味着他在2026赛季仍未取得分站冠军。
「我把所有能用的办法都用上了。」维斯塔潘谈到超越拉塞尔的尝试时说，其间他还数次在16号弯入口擦到护墙。
「当然，最后一圈因为有黄旗，我觉得乔治出现了一点助推迟滞，所以他出15号弯时没能拉开，这给了我多一点机会，这也是为什么冲线会那么接近。我们一直只差一秒，彼此非常接近。」
（来源：Formula 1 官网）
detailEn: Max Verstappen came close to taking his first victory of the season at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Max Verstappen admits he "was trying everything" to claim victory on the streets of Baku, the Red Bull driver eventually falling short by just one tenth against George Russell.
The Dutchman was left a frustrated eighth on the grid for Saturday's 51-lap race after issues in Qualifying, but Verstappen quickly began to make progress with the medium tyre.
Moving into third, Verstappen demoted Oscar Piastri's McLaren for second at the first of two Safety car restarts, allowing him to challenge race leader Russell in the closing stages.
"Starting in P8 I knew it wasn't going to be that straightforward but we worked our way quite nicely up into the top three but that first stint was very tricky," said the four-time World Champion.
"That medium tyre was just not very good, not having the grip that I think the soft tyres had so was just trying to survive on that stint to try and stay with the guys on the soft.
"I think that Safety Car came at the right time for everyone to box onto that soft, because once we were on that soft tyre, it felt a lot better, just miles faster.
"I think that also showed once George and I were on the soft, we were pulling away quite a lot over everyone else."
Verstappen stayed on the cusp of a one second gap to Russell over the final laps down the main straight, with Red Bull enjoying straight-line speed during the race.

A yellow flag at Turn 15 after Valtteri Bottas crashed gifted Verstappen the chance to gain an even stronger slipstream on the run to the line for the final time. But the Dutchman ultimately fell short by just one tenth, meaning he has still yet to record a victory during the 2026 season.
"I was trying everything that I have available," said Verstappen in his quest to pass Russell, which included glancing the wall on the entry to Turn 16 several times.

"Of course on the last lap because there was a yellow, I think George picked up a bit of boost lag, so he didn't pull out of Turn 15 and that gave me a little bit more of an opportunity and that's why it was so close to the line. We were constantly one second, so we were very close to each other."

Source: Formula 1 (formula1.com). Original article: https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/i-was-trying-everything-verstappen-gives-verdict-after-missing-out-on-azerbaijan-gp-victory.6M9zlnYYDH8w4AnRIninDX

他认为最后一圈15号弯的黄旗让拉塞尔出现助推迟滞，给了他更多机会，所以冲线才会那么接近
这位四届世界冠军至今仍未拿到2026赛季的分站冠军

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
